name: Channel Zero
description: A horror anthology series inspired by “Creepypasta” online tales.

videos.title: You Have to Go Inside
videos.overview: Child psychologist Mike Painter investigates the 1988 murders of several children, including his twin brother, which may involve a children's TV show that has started airing again.

videos.title: I'll Hold Your Hand
videos.overview: Marla agrees to help Mike investigate the murders; Marla is horrified to learn a secret about what happened in 1988 that's been hidden since that time.

videos.title: Want to See Something Cool?
videos.overview: Mike must convince Gary that Candle Cove is behind the murders before he takes justice into his own hands; Marla, Jessica, and Amy frantically search for Mike before it's too late.

videos.title: A Strange Vessel
videos.overview: Mike's daughter Lily mysteriously arrives in Iron Hill, leading to more information about the murders of 1988; Mike and Jessica take drastic measures to heal the past and protect Lily from Candle Cove.

videos.title: Guest of Honor
videos.overview: Mike and Amy learn that the creator of Candle Cove isn't who they think he is; a brutal crime shocks the Iron Hill police force.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: Mike prepares to confront Candle Cove and save his daughter Lily, while Marla is faced with making an impossible choice.

videos.title: This Isn't Real
videos.overview: Four friends learn that the No-End House is more than just a haunted mansion when they confront bizarrely personal horrors in each room.

videos.title: Nice Neighborhood
videos.overview: Margot and Jules deal with the presence of The Father as Seth and JT set off on their own terrifying paths; Dylan is on a secret mission to find someone close to him.

videos.title: Beware the Cannibals
videos.overview: Margot flees The Father with the help of Jules, Seth and JT; Dylan attempts to deprogram Lacey; Jules falls deeper under the spell of a sinister influence.

videos.title: The Exit
videos.overview: The group faces the most dangerous part of House World as they search for the exit; with the Father in pursuit and shocking discoveries about each other revealed, tensions within the group simmer.

videos.title: The Damage
videos.overview: Margot, Jules, and Seth face new horror as The Father wreaks havoc in the real world.

videos.title: The Hollow Girl
videos.overview: Jules goes back inside the No-End House to rescue Margot, and together, they must finally deal with Seth and The Father to escape before it's too late.

videos.title: Insidious Onset
videos.overview: When a young woman named Alice moves to a new city, she learns about a series of disappearances that may be connected to a baffling rumor about mysterious staircases in the city's worst neighborhoods.

videos.title: Father Time
videos.overview: Alice treads the line between reality and madness as she becomes more deeply entangled with the Peach family and their dark history; Zoe begins to behave strangely following her unexplained return to Garrett.

videos.title: All You Ghost Mice
videos.overview: Alice has a terrifying encounter in an abandoned hospital; Luke, Louise and Nathan play cat-and-mouse with Robert Peach.

videos.title: Alice in Slaughterland
videos.overview: Alice confronts her own incipient madness while Zoe eats with the Peaches.

videos.title: The Red Door
videos.overview: Zoe discovers there's something else living in the summer house; Alice reaches the point of no return.

videos.title: Sacrifice Zone
videos.overview: Zoe and Alice confront the Peach family.

videos.title: Ashes on My Pillow
videos.overview: An unsettling discovery prompts newlyweds Jillian and Tom Hodgson to suspect their home is haunted by past secrets.

videos.title: Where Did You Sleep Last Night?
videos.overview: After witnessing a murder, Jillian digs into secrets from her past; Tom realizes he's in danger.

videos.title: Love Hurts
videos.overview: A terrified Jillian and Tom reveal their secrets and try to overcome the devastating consequences.

videos.title: Bizarre Love Triangle
videos.overview: As Jillian's old friend relentlessly hunts Tom, she teams up with a neighbor to try and save him.

videos.title: You Belong to Me
videos.overview: Ian makes a grand gesture that threatens to drive Jillian and Tom apart forever.

videos.title: Two of Us
videos.overview: The Hodgsons set out to defeat the demons in their marriage once and for all.
